:::{#def-cv-estimate}
#### Cross-validation estimate

The **$\nfolds$-fold cross-validation estimate** $\cvest{\nfolds}$
is the [mean squared error](prediction.qmd#def-prediction-mse)
of the predictions that each observation $\iobs \in \obsidx$ of the training set receives
from the [fold-out rule](#def-fold-out-rule) of its
[fold assignment](#def-fold-assignment) $\foldof{\iobs}$
in [$\nfolds$-fold cross-validation](#def-kfold):

$$
\cvest{\nfolds} \eqdef \frac{1}{\nobs} \sum_{\iobs \in \obsidx} \sqf{\fittedwo{\foldof{\iobs}}{\predvar_{\iobs}} - \outvar_{\iobs}}.
$$ {#eq-cv-estimate}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.10.1], for the per-observation form with the fold index $\foldof{\iobs}$.
:::
